description: Keeps every pinned dependency of this repo current.
Auto lane: upstream php/node patch or digest updates in docker-bake.hcl merge without review once pr and
renovate-guard are green. Everything else waits for a human. See .design-log/001-v3-architecture.md section 4.1.

customManagers.description: Upstream base image of every line in docker-bake.hcl (one row per line).
Tool images pinned by tag + digest inside workflow run steps (hadolint, shellcheck, actionlint, trivy).
Doppler CLI version installed in the images.

packageRules.description: A line is fixed to its minor (php 8.4 stays 8.4). New lines come from scripts/new-versions.sh, not from Renovate.
Auto lane (.design-log/001 §4.1). renovate-guard re-checks the diff and the registry digest; the master-review ruleset lets only this app skip the review, never the checks.
